Liam: Two-line rule: drop a movie/book/show rec + one song that fits + one snack you'd eat while watching/reading. No explanations >2 lines. I'll compile. :popcorn:

Priya: 'Harold and Maude' (film) + Shuggie Otis 'Strawberry Letter 23' + salted pistachios :nail_care:

omar: 'The Leftovers' (TV) + Bon Iver 'Holocene' + black coffee (no milk) :coffee:

Nadia: Book: 'Never Let Me Go' + The National 'I Need My Girl' + brown butter cookie :cookie:

Liam: Show: 'Only Murders in the Building' + Al Green 'Let's Stay Together' + sweet-and-sour pickles (weird but good) :eyes:

Priya: quick add: short film rec 0 min: 'World of Tomorrow' + LCD Soundsystem 'Someone Great' + gummy bears :clown_face:

omar: @jukebox-bot can you make a 25-min mix with these 5 tracks? No remixes, please.

jukebox-bot: Playlist generated: "Two-Line Watchlist & Snacks" 17 min  https://open.spotify.com/playlist/4yExample (5 tracks added) :headphones:

Nadia: Poll: react :thumbsup: for film mood, :heart: for show binge, :laughing: for book+cookie combo.

Liam: :thumbsup: for film mood (Harold & Maude forever)

omar: :heart: for show binge (Leftovers is a rewatch)

Priya: :laughing: for gummy bears and World of Tomorrow :grin:

Nadia: I'll drop these in the #watercooler-recs doc later. Also, optional snack recipe in case anyone's curious:

```
Brown butter cookie: 1 stick butter, brown until nutty, mix 1 cup sugar + 1 egg + 1.5 cups flour + 1 tsp baking soda, fold browned butter, chill 30 min, bake 10-12 min.
```

Liam: bookmarking that recipe rn :yum: Thanks y'all, love this format — fast and very portable for commutes.

omar: small PSA: headphones on trains, but share snacks at the kitchen table any time :raised_hands:
